Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract return type if present # Enhanced return type detection return_type = "unknown" sig_return = block.find(class_="sig-return") if sig_return: return_type = sig_return.get_text(strip=True) else: # Use regex to infer return type from signature match = re.search(r"->\s*([\w\[\], ]+)", signature) if match: return_type = match.group(1).strip() else: # Fallback to infer return type from signature match = re.search(r"->\s*([\w\[\], ]+)", signature) if match: return_type = match.group(1).strip() # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = "" params_info = {} if dd: # Get main description from first paragraph # Improved description extraction for nested structures description = "" first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: # Check for other nested structures (e.g., div, ul) nested_div = dd.find("div") if nested_div: description = nested_div.get_text(strip=True)[:300] else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] # Extract parameter descriptions from dl/dt/dd structure param_list = dd.find("dl", class_="field-list") if param_list: for param_dt in param_list.find_all("dt"): param_name = param_dt.get_text(strip=True) param_dd = param_dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if param_dd: params_info[param_name] = param_dd.get_text(strip=True)[:150] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature, params_info), "return_type": return_type, }) #
